{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
if df['revenue'].dtype != 'object':
    df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(str)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (they are not valid conversions)
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Calculate conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
if len(filtered_df) == 0:
    conversion_rate = 0.0
else:
    conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print result
print(conversion_rate)"}
